title: The proved source-library regular local UFD theorem
statement: Let A be a commutative regular local ring which is also a regular ring (every prime localization is regular local), in the sense of [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Then A is a unique factorization domain.

source.place: Tag 0AG0, lemma-regular-local-UFD; already proved source-library specialization IsRegularLocalRing.uniqueFactorizationMonoid in WeilConjectures.RingTheory.RegularLocalRing.UniqueFactorization, lines 43-135.

proof.text: Use the existing proved source declaration IsRegularLocalRing.uniqueFactorizationMonoid A, with precisely the stated regular-local and regular-ring instances. This is a one-line application, not a new unproved UFD assertion. The source declaration proves the result by strong induction on the embedding dimension: localizations at nonmaximal primes have smaller dimension and are UFDs; choose a prime parameter x; ideals minimal over nonzero principal ideals of A[1/x] are locally principal by induction, hence invertible. Their contractions have finite projective dimension over A, so their localizations are stably free. An invertible stably free module is free, making those ideals principal. The principal-prime criterion makes A[1/x] a UFD and Nagata descent makes A a UFD. The field case starts the induction. All of this argument is already formalized in the attached source module; no statement or proof in that source module is changed.
